content.short: Levr Bet offers prediction markets on sports with 2x to 5x leverage on single-game lines.
content.description: Levr Bet applies leverage to sports prediction markets on Monad, letting participants take amplified positions on single-game lines. Leverage on event outcomes is a sharper instrument than leverage on prices, since the position resolves to zero or full value rather than moving continuously toward a liquidation.
